name: walk_block_grid_for_blits
description: Walks a five-step grid of memory blocks, advancing by a large fixed stride and flipping a parity value between passes, invoking a helper for each block and calling a blitter wait helper.

name: program_blitter_rectangle_copy
description: Waits for the blitter to go idle, then programs control, mask, modulo, pointer and size registers for a rectangular blit whose width and height come from the differences between two coordinates.

name: setup_blitter_line_octant
description: Computes the absolute horizontal and vertical distances between two points, records the octant from their signs and major axis, waits for the blitter to be idle, then programs the line-drawing registers with the error terms and size.

name: compose_digit_prefixed_text
description: Writes a digit character derived from a register value and a second byte into a scratch buffer, appends a zero-terminated source string, passes the resulting length to a helper, and copies the finished text to the destination while clearing a status word.

name: poll_fire_button_text_input
description: Copies a prompt string into a buffer, clears a set of screen buffers, then loops reading the fire button state from the CIA port and a keyboard helper until a terminating character arrives.

name: decode_keyboard_text_input
description: Reads a raw keycode from the keyboard serial register, performs the keyboard acknowledge handshake, maps digits and characters through a lookup table and stores accepted characters until Return or Escape ends entry.

name: process_input_event_code
description: Compares an event code against three values and stores a passed byte for each match, clearing a buffer entry for one code unless a flag blocks it, and returns whether a matched code was seen.

name: start_word_wrap_layout
description: Resets the layout state for a text block and enters the shared line-wrapping loop, which breaks lines at spaces and newlines when the column width is passed.

name: wrap_text_with_callback
description: Lays out text character by character, breaking lines at spaces and newlines when the column limit is reached, and calls a supplied callback at the end when one is given.

name: blit_narrow_strip_pair
description: Programs the blitter for narrow two-word-wide strips of a given height, setting source, destination and mask registers, and repeats the setup for a second pass when a flag is set.

name: scan_marked_text_line
description: Skips a two-byte header marker if present, then reads characters from a text line through a substitution table, stopping at a line break or terminator and resetting a state byte on exit.

name: read_fire_buttons_and_flags
description: Reads the fire button bits from the CIA port and forces a counter to a fixed limit when a button is released, then sets threshold flags from a shifted position and updates a mask word when the flag is active.

name: tick_timer_and_invert_mask
description: Increments a byte counter and counts a timer down, and when the timer reaches zero resets it to ten and inverts two 32-bit mask words with a fixed bit pattern.

name: multiply_absolute_halfwords
description: Takes the absolute values of two register inputs and returns a 64-bit pair whose first part is the product of one input's high half and the other's low half, with the second input's halves swapped.

name: check_position_window_and_update
description: Subtracts two position values and, when the difference lies inside a fixed window, runs four update helpers, otherwise clearing two state bytes.

name: update_window_state_or_reset
description: Compares two position values and runs four helpers when the difference falls inside a fixed window; outside it clears one state field, stores a fixed constant in another and calls a helper.

name: build_copper_color_and_plane_list
description: Fills a copper list buffer with bitplane pointer words spaced by a fixed stride, writes sixteen colour register move pairs from the colour zero register onward, and writes a set of fixed wait and move words.

name: build_copper_palette_from_source
description: Writes bitplane pointer entries and colour register move pairs starting at the second colour register, and when a packed palette source exists, expands its 4-bit components into colour words and stores a masked, shifted colour value.

name: merge_copper_list_entries
description: Writes a fixed set of copper list words, then ORs each pair of entries into a second list and zeroes the odd slots across a fixed block of entries.

name: set_bitplane_pointers_for_row
description: Clamps a vertical position into a valid row range, computes the matching row address from a stride, and writes the high and low halves of four bitplane pointers spaced by a row length into a structure.

name: write_sprite_header_from_offsets
description: Packs a horizontal and a vertical position into a two-word sprite control longword, adding a fixed offset to the high byte and switching to an alternate offset when a flag is set, with the low bit set when an extra position bit is present.

name: write_sprite_header_from_position
description: Packs a horizontal position and a control bit into a sprite header longword with a fixed base offset, using an alternate offset when a flag is set and setting the low bit from a separate position flag.

name: copy_indexed_entry_or_clear
description: Selects a source table by comparing the destination pointer against known buffers, then copies one fifteen-longword entry at an index, or zeroes the fifteen longwords when no source applies.

name: clear_fifteen_longwords
description: Writes zero to fifteen consecutive longwords starting at the target pointer.

name: store_mouse_port_direction_bits
description: Masks the movement value read from the mouse port register and stores its two direction bit pairs into a state longword.

name: decode_mouse_joystick_direction
description: Reads the quadrature movement bits of the mouse and joystick ports, converts them into X and Y direction flags, and cancels any pair of opposing directions that are both set.

name: emit_clamped_segment_words
description: Calculates a clamped horizontal offset, writes a series of setup words for a segment with waits between them, halves two stored values when a status bit is clear, and repeats a pair of passes when a counter flag is nonzero.

name: setup_blitter_for_clamped_segment
description: Calculates a clamped horizontal offset, waits for the blitter, writes a series of control words for a segment, halves two stored values when a status bit is clear, and repeats a pair of passes when a counter flag is nonzero.

name: load_named_level_and_graphics
description: Copies a level file name and a graphics map name into a path buffer, loads each through library calls bracketed by system disable and enable and blitter ownership, sets the background colour and DMA control, and loops forever if a lookup returns nothing.

name: compute_angle_from_vector
description: Folds two signed components into absolute values and quadrant bits, divides the smaller by the larger, looks up a table value for the ratio, and returns it offset by the quadrant.

name: smooth_active_record_fields
description: Walks a list of twelve-word records and, for each active record with its flag set, moves two 32-bit fields a shifted fraction of the way toward a table-derived target, stopping at the end of the list or when the control bit is set.

name: update_moving_object_list
description: Walks a fixed table of twelve-word entries, advancing each active entry by its velocity, toggling or clearing its bit in the playfield at the new position when it moves out of bounds or meets another bit, and deactivating an entry when its counter runs out.

name: probe_playfield_bits_at_point
description: Computes a byte address and bit from a point and reads the playfield bit in three stacked rows, then returns without changing anything, so the result is not used in the shown code.

name: spawn_moving_object_entry
description: Finds the first free twelve-word entry in a table, fills in its position, a velocity taken from a lookup table scaled by a shift, a lifetime of one hundred eighty ticks and an active flag, then increments a count of created entries.

name: build_ram_startup_script
description: Copies the command line path into a buffer, and when it is non-empty, composes a startup script with assign, copy and run lines for the game directory and a RAM copy, writes it out and returns success, otherwise returning an error code.

name: open_write_and_close_file
description: Opens a file through the DOS library and, when the handle is valid, records it, writes the buffered text and closes the file, returning one on success and zero when the open fails.

name: write_zero_terminated_string
description: Measures a zero-terminated string and passes it to the DOS write routine.

name: open_console_and_dos_library
description: Opens the DOS library and, if that succeeds, opens a console window with a fixed title, position and size, recording both handles, and returns zero on success or one on failure.

name: close_console_and_library
description: Closes the console file handle and the DOS library when a handle was recorded.

name: store_value_into_many_globals
description: Writes an input value into about two dozen fixed memory slots, stores a second input in one more, and returns a constant pair, so it reads as a table initialiser rather than a computation.

name: dispatch_record_log_operation
description: Dispatches on a mode number to one of several operations on a saved record block, such as searching or appending a logged record, checking a stored checksum and resetting the block, or formatting record text.

name: copy_base_name_before_dot
description: Copies the base part of a file name up to its first dot into a buffer, records a header marker and handler pointer when the first input is zero, and resets two state bytes.

name: format_percent_gain_text
description: Writes the two digits of a percentage into the output text, deriving the value from a ratio of stored record fields when the record tag matches, and terminates the text.

name: write_dash_flag_suffix
description: Writes a parenthesised suffix made of two dash characters and a flag digit chosen from two fields, then records the positions of the two text fields.

name: clear_and_format_plural_suffix
description: Clears several text output buffers, then copies either a plural suffix ending in a dot or a bare dot into the output depending on a count field.

name: format_duration_hours_minutes
description: Converts a count of time units into whole minutes with rounding, then writes an hours part and a minutes part with singular or plural wording into the output text.

name: write_decimal_number_text
description: Writes an optional two-byte prefix and then the decimal digits of a value, suppressing leading zeros, into the output buffer.

name: clear_buffer_and_write_terminator
description: Clears a 120-byte buffer referenced from a record and writes an end marker word into a second buffer pointer.

name: store_block_checksum_word
description: Sums the words of a data block and stores the negated total mixed with a fixed key into the block header word.

name: xor_chain_word_block
description: Walks a word block backwards applying an exclusive-or chain with a fixed key, transforming each word in place from its neighbour.

name: xor_chain_word_block_forward
description: Walks a word block forwards, replacing each word with the exclusive-or of itself, its successor and a fixed key.

name: upsert_record_and_keep_maximum
description: Looks up a record by its identifier in a list, appending a new one with its values and text when it is absent, and otherwise keeps the stored maximum value and updates its text only when the new value is larger.

name: expand_packed_tile_picture
description: Decodes packed tile picture data into a working buffer by exclusive-or with a key byte, clears and copies twenty-word column strips for each row, and builds the blit mask for each column position.

name: blit_packed_tile_picture_rows
description: Decodes packed tile picture rows with an exclusive-or key and blits each tile, waiting on the blitter between operations and choosing the mask from the column position.

name: scroll_tile_buffer_rows
description: Moves rows of a tile buffer by one step, copying twenty-word strips and clearing the vacated strip, repeating until the row count runs out.

name: wait_for_blitter_idle
description: Spins while the blitter-busy bit of the DMA control read is set, returning once the blitter is idle.

name: decode_marker_run_length_data
description: Checks a two-byte signature, then decodes run-length data: literal bytes are copied, a marker byte introduces a repeat run with its count, and a run that would overflow the output returns an error code.

name: fill_memory_with_byte
description: Fills a memory region with a given byte, aligning to a word boundary first, writing four-byte groups and then the remaining bytes.

name: open_logfile_or_show_red
description: Opens the log file through the DOS library and keeps the handle, closing it again, or when the open fails sets the background colour to red for a long delay loop as an error indication.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Holds only one unimplemented instruction that halts decoding, so there is no real behaviour; it is a stub in the shared maths library.

name: store_library_base_pointer
description: Saves the library base pointer passed in the address register into a global slot.

name: free_library_or_mark_pending
description: When the usage count is zero, unlinks the library node from its list and frees its memory through the exec library, returning the base; otherwise it sets a pending-removal flag and returns zero.

name: mark_library_pending_expunge
description: Sets a pending-removal flag bit in a library structure and returns zero.

name: open_library_and_count_users
description: Increments the library open count when it is not pending removal, initialises the library on the first open by calling a setup routine with the math library name, and returns the base, or minus one when it is pending removal.

name: decrement_counter_and_call
description: Decrements a short counter stored in a structure and, if the counter reaches zero and a specific flag bit is set, calls another routine; when the counter reaches zero it also calls a further routine with a fixed argument.

name: forward_to_library_routine
description: Calls one other library routine and returns without changing anything else.

name: bitwise_float_mantissa_loop
description: Returns zero unchanged and forwards negative inputs to another routine, otherwise runs a bit-by-bit loop that shifts the working mantissa and sets result bits until its sign test ends it.

name: bit_serial_division_step
description: Sets a bit in the first value selected by the second, then repeatedly doubles a running remainder while shifting the divisor word, subtracting until the remainder goes negative or the count runs out, and returns the merged quotient bits with the count word.

name: call_vector_and_set_flag_bits
description: Calls a library routine through a fixed vector and adjusts its result by clearing one flag bit and setting another.

name: call_jump_table_entries
description: Calls a fixed sequence of library routines through function pointers at set offsets from the library base, alternating between two entries and invoking a third once in the middle.

name: ffp_sign_case_dispatch
description: Calls library vectors to test operand state, then runs one of several sequences of vector calls depending on those tests, and returns the result with two flag bits adjusted.

name: ffp_sign_case_dispatch_variant
description: Calls library vectors to test operand state, runs a sequence of vector calls depending on those tests, then picks one of three vector sequences from a sign test and returns the result with two flag bits cleared.

name: choose_sequence_on_zero_and_sign
description: Calls a status vector, then chooses one of three library call sequences based on a zero test and the sign of a value, and returns the result with a fixed bit mask applied.

name: choose_sequence_on_optional_double_call
description: Calls a status vector, optionally calls a vector twice when a value is nonzero, then chooses one of three library call sequences based on the sign of a value and returns the result with a fixed bit mask applied.

name: choose_tail_sequence_by_sign
description: Chooses one of three library call sequences from the sign of a value and a second zero test, then returns the result with a fixed bit mask applied.

name: call_vector_and_mask_result
description: Calls one library vector and returns its result with two flag bits cleared.

name: call_vector_twice_and_mask
description: Calls a library vector twice and returns its result with two flag bits cleared.

name: mask_return_value
description: Calls a function through a pointer stored in a global variable twice, then calls another routine and returns its result with certain bits cleared.

name: call_first_library_vector
description: Loads a library base from a global slot and calls the library vector at one fixed offset from it, returning its result.

name: call_second_library_vector
description: Loads a library base from a global slot and calls a different library vector at another fixed offset from it, returning its result.

name: bit_serial_root_iteration
description: Builds a result over up to twenty-four shift-and-subtract steps by comparing a shifted working value against a decreasing power-of-two term, then calls a finishing routine and a second step when a sign flag is set.

name: bit_serial_root_short_entry
description: Runs the same kind of bit-serial shift-and-subtract loop from a shorter entry point, with a bit counter that ends the loop early and a finishing call when it expires.

name: shift_loop_until_counter_expires
description: Repeatedly shifts and subtracts a working value while decrementing a counter, and when the counter expires it calls the library reschedule routine and returns.

name: compute_trig_by_shift_rotation
description: Reduces an angle argument into one period using fixed reduction constants, then runs table-driven shift-and-add rotation steps to produce sine and cosine values passed to output routines.

name: compute_tangent_by_shift_rotation
description: Uses the same reduction and rotation steps as the sine routine, then calls a divide step only when the cosine part is nonzero, producing a tangent-style result.

name: compute_arctangent_by_subtraction
description: Reduces the argument like the trigonometric routines, then runs table-driven subtraction steps until the residual changes sign, and passes the accumulated angle to a finishing routine.

name: compute_trig_with_stacked_flag
description: Runs the reduction and rotation steps, then branches on a stacked sign argument, calling a divide step and a finishing routine, with a second branch used when that argument is minus one.

name: compute_angle_by_table_subtraction
description: Reduces the argument, then subtracts table values in a fixed number of steps to accumulate an angle, which is passed to a finishing routine when the stacked flag is negative.

name: compute_rotation_with_flag_branch
description: Makes three library calls, reduces the argument, runs table-driven rotation steps, and finishes along a branch chosen by a stacked flag.

name: step_rotation_by_increment
description: Adds a repeated increment to an argument until it reaches a bound, then runs rotation steps and finishes according to a stacked flag.

name: compute_arctangent_with_stacked_flag
description: Runs table-driven subtraction steps to accumulate an angle from its argument, then branches on a stacked sign flag, calling a divide step and a finishing routine, with one branch used when that flag is minus one.

name: run_rotation_loop_with_flag
description: Runs a fixed number of rotation steps that add and subtract shifted components of two accumulators, choosing each direction from the sign of a third accumulator, then finishes according to a stacked flag.

name: return_without_effect
description: Returns immediately without changing any registers or memory.

name: forward_call_then_return
description: Makes one call to another routine and then returns.

name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two other routines in sequence and returns.

name: convert_integer_to_float_format
description: Converts a signed integer into the library floating-point form by taking its magnitude, shifting it until the top bit is set, and building the exponent from a base value that depends on the sign.

name: normalize_integer_to_float_form
description: Normalises an integer into the same floating-point form as its sibling routine, returning early when a shared test on an accompanying word shows that no conversion is needed.

name: call_routine_then_pair
description: Calls one routine and then two more in sequence, because the guard flag is set to false before the check so the sequence always runs.

name: call_routine_then_triple
description: Calls one routine and then three more in sequence, because the guard flag is fixed to false so the sequence always runs.

name: step_byte_and_call_twice
description: When a byte argument is nonzero and not at its signed limit, calls a check routine and, if it passes, calls two routines with the argument incremented and then a final routine.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains no work and returns straight away to its caller.

name: stub_no_operation
description: Performs no observable work and returns to its caller.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains a single return and does nothing else.

name: stub_return_empty
description: Performs no observable work, consisting of a single return instruction sequence.

name: stub_return_no_effect
description: Performs no observable work and immediately returns.

name: shift_mantissa_by_exponent
description: Returns straight away for a zero word; otherwise derives a shift count from the exponent, shifts the mantissa by it, applies the sign and tests the result, calling several library helpers along the way.

name: call_four_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls four other routines one after another and then returns.

name: accumulate_table_by_sign
description: Walks a table of words, adding each entry to an accumulator while the accumulator is negative and subtracting it when it is not, until the counter runs out.

name: subtract_table_from_accumulator
description: Adds the first table entry to an accumulator and then subtracts the following entries while the accumulator stays non-negative, returning when the counter reaches its end value.

name: scale_value_into_float_format
description: Returns for zero, otherwise builds a mantissa by repeated shift-and-subtract steps against a power-of-two term, then derives an exponent from the magnitude byte by shifting until the top bit appears, and calls helpers to store the result.

name: stub_return_no_work
description: The decompiled body is a bare return, so no observable work appears in this routine; it is a stub in the shared maths library.

name: encode_mantissa_and_exponent
description: When the magnitude byte is nonzero, derives a mantissa by repeated shift-and-subtract steps, then derives an exponent by shifting until the top bit appears, and calls helpers to store the packed result.

name: encode_float_with_loop_exit
description: Runs a shift-and-subtract loop that finishes early when its counter expires, then packs the mantissa and exponent from the magnitude byte into the floating-point form and calls helpers to store it.

name: call_routine_thrice
description: Calls another routine three times in succession and then returns.

name: normalize_sign_and_mantissa
description: Calls one routine and returns for negative values; for positive nonzero values it shifts the mantissa by an exponent-derived count and applies a final sign correction.

name: shift_mantissa_and_check_sign
description: Calls two helpers, returns for a zero word, otherwise shifts the mantissa by an exponent-derived count, applies the sign and returns when the result is nonzero, calling helpers in between.

name: stub_empty_library_entry
description: The decompiled body is a bare return with no instructions performing work, so it is a stub entry in the shared maths library.

name: stub_return_entry_point
description: The decompiled body is a bare return, so this entry point shows no observable behaviour in the shared maths library.

name: stub_return_table_entry
description: The decompiled body is a bare return with nothing observable, so it is a stub entry in the shared maths library.

name: stub_return_table_slot
description: The decompiled body is a bare return that does nothing observable, so it is a stub slot in the shared maths library.

name: stub_return_lib_entry
description: The decompiled body is a bare return with no observable work, so this is a stub entry in the shared maths library.

name: stub_return_lib_slot
description: The decompiled body is a bare return with no observable work, so this is a stub slot in the shared maths library.

name: stub_return_lib_vector
description: The decompiled body is a bare return with no observable work, so this is a stub vector in the shared maths library.

name: invoke_callback_and_return
description: Calls the routine whose address is in the address register, then returns the value that was in the data register on entry, unchanged.

name: call_indirect_return_d0
description: Calls the routine pointed to by the address register and then returns the value that was in the data register on entry.

description: Calls a library routine through a fixed vector offset from the library base held in a global slot, then returns the data register value unchanged.

description: Calls a library routine through a fixed vector offset from the library base held in a global slot, then returns the data register value unchanged.

name: call_library_vector_by_offset
description: Calls a library routine at an address formed by adding an offset from the address register to the library base held in a global slot, then returns the data register value unchanged.

name: normalize_fixed_point_value
description: Swaps the high and low words of a signed fixed-point value, then left-shifts it while decrementing an exponent count until the count runs out or the sign bit is reached, returning early on overflow.

name: return_minus_one_result
description: Returns the constant minus one and does no other work in the shared icon library.

name: increment_counter_clear_bit
description: Increments a 16-bit counter at one offset from the base pointer and clears a single bit in a flag byte at another offset, then returns.

name: decrement_library_refcount
description: Decrements a reference counter in a library structure, calling a cleanup routine and returning its result when the counter reaches zero and a flag bit is set, otherwise returning zero.

name: free_library_or_mark_pending
description: When the usage count is zero, unlinks the library node from its list and frees its memory through the exec library, returning the saved value; otherwise it sets a pending-removal flag and returns zero.

name: mark_library_pending_expunge
description: Sets a pending-removal flag bit in a library structure and returns zero.

name: open_dos_library_or_alert
description: Stores the library base and name pointer in the library structure, opens the DOS library by name through the exec library and records its base, and raises an alert when the open fails.

name: copy_two_longwords_to_globals
description: Copies two longwords from the library structure at fixed offsets from the address register into two global slots.

description: Calls one other routine and then returns, doing nothing else in this routine.

name: call_one_helper_and_return
description: Calls one other routine and then returns, doing nothing else in this routine.

name: update_field_of_returned_object
description: Calls a routine through a function table entry using the first parameter, then stores the second parameter into the object returned at a fixed offset.

name: call_helpers_with_cleanup_on_failure
description: Calls a first helper and, when it returns a nonzero result, calls a second helper with that result; if the second helper fails it calls a cleanup helper and returns zero, otherwise it returns the first result.

name: allocate_and_fill_icon_record
description: Calls two helpers to create and fill a record, copies a ten-longword block and several fields from a stack buffer into it at fixed offsets, links it through a back pointer when its link field is nonzero, and returns it, or returns zero when a helper fails.

name: copy_fields_into_record_and_link
description: Copies a ten-longword block and eight fields from a stack-side buffer into a record at fixed offsets, then links the record back into its parent when the link field is nonzero.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns the constant zero and performs no other work in the shared icon library.

name: copy_icon_data_to_stack
description: Copies ten longwords from an offset within the icon structure, plus several more fields, into a local stack header, then calls another routine with the first two arguments and a pointer to that stack header.

name: load_icon_info_file
description: Builds a path with the info extension, checks a fixed magic word and version word in the file header, and when they match loads the icon image records and strings, returning one on success or zero on failure.

name: load_icon_image_records
description: Checks the magic and version words in the icon header, then loads and links the image record blocks, returning one on success or zero on failure.

name: load_optional_icon_blocks
description: Reads the remaining optional icon blocks, including a zero-terminated list of tool type strings, and links each into the icon record, returning one on success or zero on failure.

name: read_tool_type_string_list
description: Reads a zero-terminated list of strings one at a time, storing each pointer in turn, then reads one further optional block and returns one on success or zero on failure.

name: call_one_helper_return_zero
description: Calls one other routine and returns zero.

name: stub_return_no_effect
description: Performs no observable work and returns to its caller.

name: write_icon_info_file
description: Writes the icon header and records to a file through a path buffer, restores the saved header field afterwards, and returns one on success or zero on failure.

name: write_icon_records_through_callback
description: Writes the icon records, tool type string lists and extra blocks through a write callback, returning the final success flag.

name: write_optional_icon_blocks
description: Writes the optional icon blocks, including a zero-terminated tool type string list, through a write callback, restores the saved header field, and returns one on success or zero on failure.

name: write_tool_type_string_list
description: Counts the entries of a zero-terminated string list, writes each through a write callback, then writes one further optional block, returning one on success or zero on failure.

name: iterate_icon_table_entries
description: Walks a zero-terminated table of pointers, calling a routine on each entry and updating a counter, calls a write callback twice per entry, and then processes one optional extra entry.

name: walk_node_list_until_end
description: Walks a circular list of nodes from a starting node, calling one routine on each node found, and calls it once more on the final node when a result is left over.

name: iterate_linked_list_nodes
description: Calls a helper on the current node, follows the next pointer through a helper until the result is zero or the list wraps back to its start, then calls a helper on the final node when one remains.

name: forward_call_with_offset_argument
description: Calls another routine with the same first argument and the second argument increased by a fixed offset, then returns.

name: allocate_fixed_record_or_fail
description: Allocates a fixed-size cleared record through a helper, links it into a list field, calls a helper to fill it, and frees it again and returns zero when that fill fails, otherwise returning the record pointer.

name: call_one_helper_and_return
description: Calls one other routine and then returns, doing nothing else in this routine.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns the constant zero and performs no other work in the shared icon library.

name: store_pair_into_entry_table
description: Decrements an entry count held in a structure, growing the table through a helper when it is exhausted, then stores two longwords into the next table slot and returns one, or zero if growing fails.
